analogs.covers: Personality and role: spits at everything, dramatic, the guard animal of a bigger herd
Defence: keep moving and swing the spikes, backing its weapon into predators

headline: A spitting llama guard with porcupine spikes, the sentry of the stegosaur herd.

setting.label: Nomadic, close to water in the dry season
setting.note: Nomadic, but settles inside a Stegosaurus territory when part of a stegosaurid herd. Stays near rivers and shaded pools in the dry season; wades, bathes and rolls in mud.

playsLike: You are a medium, skittish but aggressive herbivore in a 'bristle' of up to 8 with an even sex ratio. Anything that spooks you gets spat at. You join Stegosaurus and Miragaia as the stegosaurid herd's sentry, and up to 4 of you chase threats out of the herd's sight. You keep moving and swing your spiked tail rather than standing still. A Kentrosaurus-only group flees Apex carnivores.

why.text: Its first reaction to anything that surprises it is to spit, even at other Kentrosaurus in a dispute. Llamas are famous for this (official inspiration).
Serves as the sentry of the stegosaurid herd and actively chases threats away, the way llamas are kept to guard sheep and alpacas.
'Excessively dramatic', with loud angry bellows and sudden mood swings.
'Staying in one spot … is usually fatal', so it keeps moving, swinging its spiked tail. A porcupine backs its quills into a predator the same way (official inspiration).
Medium tier, 2,700 combat weight, 750 HP, sprint 1,050 held for 143 s.

notLike: Llamas only kick and spit; Kentrosaurus carries a spiked tail that makes predators bleed.
Porcupines are solitary; Kentrosaurus lives in a bristle.
twist: Alpacas and hedgehogs are official inspirations too.
